title: Interior Space and Seating Comfort
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise rear-seat comfort, spaciousness, driving feel, and standout styling, while the negative example concerns awkward reach to the far side of the screen and several fragments are too incomplete or descriptive to determine sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight roomy rear seating, comfortable seat design, smooth or strong driving performance, useful technology, and eye-catching exterior appeal.

negative.summary: The negative review describes poor ergonomics when trying to reach items on the far passenger side of the screen.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments include incomplete anecdotes, comparisons without clear evaluation, and descriptive comments about space or seat-related observations that do not state a clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic clusters several loosely related subjects, including rear-seat space, seat comfort, driving feel, technology, and exterior appearance, so it is not a single tightly focused theme.
Several undetermined fragments are incomplete or purely descriptive, which limits how specifically they can be interpreted.
The sample is sentiment-stratified and not representative of the full review population.
